sections.Profile:
Ro Go , released by Bally Manufacturing in 1974, is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Greg Kmiec with artwork by Dave Christensen.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Swords, Vikings, Original Theme, 1970s, Fantasy, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Dave Christensen
- Design: Greg Kmiec
sections.Editions: - Ro Go: 3,075 made, released 1974-08-01, model number 1003
